name: Bac Me bamboo-tube rice
summary: Rice cooked in bamboo tubes, a specialty of Bắc Mê on the road back toward Hà Giang town. The district is also known for Bắc Mê sticky rice.
howToEat: Eat it as rice from the tube.
where: Bắc Mê, on the road back. The local stalls there are the last-morning food stop.
seoTitle: Bac Me rice — bamboo-tube and sticky rice
seoDescription: Bắc Mê bamboo-tube rice is cooked in bamboo on the road back to Hà Giang town. The district is also known for its sticky rice.
